inner_validation: all complete 2020/21+ seasons before each outer season; each forecast model is fitted only on seasons older than its validation season
carry_meaning: expected player points after opening, never ideal-squad overlap
primary_schedule: current-round fixture known; future projections decay from current per-fixture estimate toward current neutral-opponent estimate with factor 0.5^k, assuming one fixture per future round; no final future schedule
score: mean paired point gain at endpoint across inner seasons - .25 * SD of paired seasonal gains; receiver average first
stable_rule: values within max(2 points, paired SE) of best robust score; numeric groups choose centre of widest contiguous admissible range, tie nearest incumbent; chip factor categorical prefer incumbent if admissible
search: one ordered coordinate pass for each endpoint and each outer fold, no joint grid
scope: architecture and grids are retrospective research choices, previously examined seasons are not independent confirmation
forecast_hyperparameters: frozen in this pass; no new Elo K or regression-alpha sweep
checkpoint_chip_note: net points alone do not price remaining chips; bank, FT and chip stocks are reported at each endpoint; no new chip resets or forced use at GW8/12/15
